test_dropna_empty: test the Series.dropna method on an empty series and verify in-place return value is None
test_dropna_preserve_name: test the Series.dropna method preserves the series name after dropping NaN values
test_dropna_no_nan: test the Series.dropna method returns a copy when the series has no NaN values
test_dropna_intervals: test the Series.dropna method with an IntervalIndex containing NaN intervals
test_dropna_period_dtype: test the Series.dropna method with Period dtype including NaT values
test_dropna_datetime64_tz: test the Series.dropna method with datetime64 types including timezone-aware indices
test_dropna_ignore_index: test the Series.dropna method with ignore_index=True to reset the index after dropping NaN values
test_dropna_invalid_axis: test the Series.dropna method raises ValueError when an invalid axis is specified
